items.name: Who Ate the Snack? - Six Animal Food Clues

youtube.title: Who Ate the Snack? | 6 Fun Animal Food Clues for Kids
youtube.description:
Can you discover which animal ate each snack? Look closely, choose from three friendly animals, and learn a fun food fact after every answer. This gentle preschool guessing game includes rabbits, pandas, monkeys, mice, giraffes, and squirrels.

Perfect for young children practising observation, animal recognition, listening, and early reasoning.

items.name: Guess the Animal Shadow - Six Friendly Silhouettes

youtube.title: Guess the Animal Shadow | 6 Silhouette Puzzles for Kids
youtube.description:
Can you match each mystery shadow to the correct animal? Enjoy six gentle silhouette puzzles featuring a rabbit, panda, monkey, mouse, giraffe, and squirrel, with a fun fact after every reveal.

This preschool guessing game supports observation, listening, animal recognition, and early reasoning.

youtube.title: What Animal Disappeared? | Memory Game for Kids
youtube.description:
Watch the friendly animals carefully, remember every picture, and discover which animal disappears. The puzzles become gradually more challenging and finish with encouraging answers.

A gentle preschool memory game supporting concentration, visual recall, listening, and animal recognition.

youtube.title: Find the Matching Animal Picture | Preschool Visual Game
youtube.description: Look at the animal picture, then find its exact match among three friendly choices. Six colourful puzzles help young children practise visual matching, attention, listening, and animal names.

youtube.title: Ocean Animal Superpower Detectives | Amazing Facts for Kids
youtube.description:
Become an Ocean Superpower Detective! Listen to each surprising clue, choose an ocean animal, and discover how octopuses, dolphins, seahorses, sea turtles, whales, and crabs do extraordinary things.

An interactive science adventure encouraging curiosity, observation, listening, and animal vocabulary for children ages 3 to 7.

items.name: Animal Alphabet Adventure A to F

youtube.title: Animal Alphabet Adventure A-F | Learn Letters and Animals
youtube.description:
Learn the letters A, B, C, D, E, and F with six cheerful animals: alligator, bear, cat, dog, elephant, and fox. Each letter includes clear pronunciation and a simple animal fact.

A gentle early-learning video for preschool children practising letters, sounds, vocabulary, and animal recognition.

items.name: Maya and the Rainy-Day Joey Rescue

youtube.title: Maya and the Rainy-Day Joey Rescue | Kindness Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Join Maya in a gentle Australian park story about helping a young kangaroo safely. Maya notices carefully, gives the wild animal space, calls a trusted wildlife helper, waits calmly, and celebrates a family reunion from far away.

A connected Tiny Tales kindness adventure supporting empathy, safe wildlife choices, listening, emotional regulation, and thoughtful action for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Nia's Rainbow Breakfast Dance | Colours and Movement for Kids
youtube.description:
Dance through a colourful breakfast morning with Nia and three lively fruit friends. Children clap, tap, stretch, turn, identify red, yellow and blue, and hear gentle food-safety guidance for family breakfast time.

An original Tiny Tales 3D-look music-and-movement adventure for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Animal Action Alphabet A-Z | Move and Learn with 26 Animals
youtube.description:
Move through the whole alphabet with 26 lively animal friends. Children amble, bounce, creep, dance, stomp, jump, stretch, gallop, waddle, flap, zigzag and try many more safe actions from A to Z.

An original Tiny Tales 3D-look alphabet-and-movement parade supporting letter recognition, animal vocabulary, listening and active play for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Brio's Paintbrush Colour Workshop | Paint, Mix and Move for Kids
youtube.description:
Help Brio restore a giant blank canvas in an original colour-and-movement music story. Children air-paint red circles, yellow rays and blue waves, mix orange and green, then bring a whole canvas meadow to life.

A Tiny Tales 3D-look art adventure supporting primary colours, early colour mixing, creative movement, listening and imagination for children ages 3 to 7.

items.name: Tavi the Tiny Train's Shape Delivery Day

youtube.title: Tavi the Tiny Train's Shape Delivery Day | Shapes and Sequencing for Kids
youtube.description:
Ride with Tavi through a cheerful community as four important deliveries arrive in order: first a round drum, next a square reading cushion, then triangle playground flags, and last rectangular seed trays. Children trace shapes, move their arms, and remember first, next, then and last.

An original Tiny Tales 3D-look railway story supporting shape recognition, sequencing, listening and movement for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Star Friends' Twinkle Playground | Movement and Bedtime Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Bounce on a cloud trampoline, balance on a moon seesaw, swoop down a comet slide and follow a sparkling constellation path with three original Star Friends. The playful movement adventure finishes with a gentle breathing moment and a calm goodnight.

An original Tiny Tales 3D-look sky story supporting listening, movement patterns, balance, imagination and bedtime transitions for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: The Cardboard Box Invention Club | Imagination Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Join Amara, Ben, and Kai as one cardboard box becomes a pretend bus, a cozy cave, a puppet theatre, and a calm reading nook. Children can steer, point, ring, explore, make hand puppets, clap, turn a pretend page, and celebrate building together.

An original Tiny Tales imagination story supporting collaborative play, creativity, listening, movement, sequencing, and calm transitions for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Niko's Ninja Soccer Kindness Match | Teamwork Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Join Niko and new player Lila for a colourful soccer story about calm focus, gentle passes, trying again, and making sure everyone belongs. Children can balance, follow the footwork, cheer a first touch, trace a passing triangle, and celebrate a kindness-team goal.

An original Tiny Tales sports story supporting coordination, confidence, friendship, resilience, and teamwork for children ages 3 to 7.

items.name: The Ant and Grasshopper's Shared Harvest

youtube.title: The Ant and Grasshopper's Shared Harvest | Musical Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Ant and Grasshopper tell an original musical story about work, music, planning, kindness, and sharing. Follow the friends as they roll a berry, rescue the autumn harvest, share warmth in winter, and grow a spring garden together.

An original Tiny Tales musical fable for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Lina's Feelings Weather Studio | Emotional Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Join Lina and Nimbus in a magical weather studio where sunshine, storms, rain and fog help them notice joy, anger, sadness and worry. The friends practise sharing space, slow breathing, asking for company and taking one small step.

An original Tiny Tales emotional-learning story for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Five Little Ducks' River Countdown | Nursery Song for Kids
youtube.description:
Follow five little ducklings through a handcrafted river journey as their visible group counts down from five to one. Mother Duck follows their colourful leaf trail, and the whole family reunites for a warm count-up finale.

A new original Tiny Tales musical arrangement and river story for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Rory's Eight-Planet Postcard Adventure | Space Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Fly with Rory from Mercury to Neptune as his little postcard rocket visits all eight planets in their correct order. See Mercury's craters, Venus's clouds, blue Earth, red Mars, giant Jupiter, Saturn's rings, sideways Uranus and windy Neptune before Rory builds a postcard map at home.

An original Tiny Tales space story for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Eddie Excavator's Rain-Garden Day | Musical Construction Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Sing through a careful construction day with Eddie Excavator. Follow the plan, watch one safe scoop and carry, help plant after the machine stops, and test how a rain garden guides water to thirsty roots.

An original Tiny Tales musical story about construction sequencing, water, plants, teamwork and work-zone safety for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Dad's Coming-Home Welcome Rhythm | Family Song for Kids
youtube.description:
Mina watches afternoon turn to evening, prepares a picture and chooses her own comfortable greeting. When Dad arrives, he follows her wave and they make a gentle three-beat home rhythm together.

An original Tiny Tales musical story about anticipation, family connection, consent, choices and turn-taking for children ages 3 to 7.

items.name: Pick, Wash, Pack the Fruit Picnic

youtube.title: Pick, Wash, Pack the Fruit Picnic | Orchard Song for Kids
youtube.description:
Kai asks before entering Rosa's orchard, gently picks ripe fruit, counts six pieces, washes them, packs a repeating colour pattern and shares the basket on a sunny picnic.

An original Tiny Tales musical story about permission, gentle food handling, counting, patterns, teamwork and avoiding waste for children ages 3 to 7.

youtube.title: Felix Firefly's Night-Light Parade | Pattern Story for Kids
youtube.description:
Felix helps Rabbit and Hedgehog remember two glowing colour patterns, care for one another and light a safe woodland path before their joyful night parade.

An original Tiny Tales musical story about patterns, courage, friendship and moving together for children ages 3 to 7.
